mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT d.id FROM t_document d LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_space ks ON d.space_id = ks.id AND ks.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_document_permission dp ON d.id = dp.document_id AND dp.principal_type = 'user' AND dp.principal_id = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND ( d.creator_id = #{userId} OR ks.visibility = 'public' OR (ks.visibility = 'department' AND ks.department_id = #{deptId} AND #{deptId} IS NOT NULL) OR ks.creator_id = #{userId} OR dp.id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY d.id

SELECT d.id AS id, d.file_name AS fileName, d.file_size AS fileSize, d.processing_status AS status, d.chunk_count AS chunkCount, d.create_time AS createTime FROM t_document d WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.creator_id = #{userId} ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.id AS id, d.file_name AS fileName, dept.name AS departmentName, d.creator_id AS creatorId, u.name AS creatorName, d.create_time AS createTime FROM t_document d LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_space ks ON d.space_id = ks.id AND ks.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_department dept ON ks.department_id = dept.id AND dept.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_user u ON d.creator_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND ( ks.visibility = 'public' OR (ks.visibility = 'department' AND ks.department_id = #{deptId} AND #{deptId} IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
